breakdown.description: Differential pressure is 20% of static, implying high Mach number where compressibility effects are non-negligible
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to recognize that the high differential pressure relative to the static pressure (20%) indicates that compressibility effects are significant. Instead of switching to the correct compressible relations as the ground truth does, the agent explicitly instructed to 'Use the incompressible Bernoulli equation for the calculation', which is the core error of the original prompt.

breakdown.description: Incompressible Bernoulli underestimates velocity at higher Mach numbers
breakdown.reason: The agent did not correct the flawed methodology. By instructing to use the 'incompressible Bernoulli equation', it perpetuated the error that would lead to an underestimation of velocity. The ground truth correctly replaces this with 'compressible isentropic relations' to get an accurate result.
